Text: One API format shouldn’t dictate which models and providers your application can use.

New API is an LLM gateway and AI asset management system for teams managing authorized model APIs through one control plane.

It helps you connect clients and upstream services by routing requests and converting between supported OpenAI-compatible, Claude, and Gemini formats.

Key features:
• API coverage – supports OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, Realtime, Claude Messages, Gemini, and rerank interfaces
• Format conversion – translates supported OpenAI-compatible, Claude Messages, and Gemini request formats
• Request routing – provides weighted channel selection, automatic retry on failure, and user-level model rate limits
• Access and accounting – includes token grouping, model restrictions, usage dashboards, and cost accounting
• Deployment options – runs with Docker or Docker Compose using SQLite, MySQL, or PostgreSQL

It’s open-source under AGPLv3, with additional Section 7 attribution and original-project-link requirements for modified user interfaces.
